description: Coordinate engineering delivery dependencies and evidence-linked progress.

provenance.author: LiNKskills Library
provenance.source: Pinned upstream modules copied with licenses and exact commit identities; see references/upstream/SOURCE-MANIFEST.json
provenance.license: See per-source upstream license copies and manifest

routing.when_to_use: Coordinate engineering delivery dependencies and evidence-linked progress.
when_not_to_use: A different task requires its own skill
exclusion_rules: Missing facts block the affected conclusion, not harmless drafting
ambiguity_rules: Read existing authorized evidence first; ask only material unanswered questions

required_inputs.name: task_inputs
required_inputs.description: approved technical PRD and execution plan; Module/Phase/Issue dependencies; executor and integration evidence

expected_outputs.name: work_product
expected_outputs.description: delivery status and blockers; dependency/owner handoffs; acceptance and release evidence gaps

forbidden_actions: Unapproved payments, filings, postings, signatures, purchases, external announcements or production changes
Inventing source facts, approval or canon
verification_steps: Read the current approved IDE Development workflow and technical PRD; use LiNKtrend Module > Phase > Issue > Executor structure.
Map concurrent dependency-aware waves, accountable project orchestrator, issue owners and exact branches/commits; do not substitute a generic Scrum ceremony for the approved workflow.
Inspect source and acceptance evidence through approved interfaces; task completion differs from integrated, deployed and operational results.
Identify critical dependencies, integration/review readiness and cross-Program blockers; Eric owns technical coordination and recovery.
Return bounded delivery evidence and business decisions for Sara/Lisa without executing production changes or changing another task's ownership.
completion_criteria: Task output meets contract and task-specific acceptance criteria
Sources, uncertainty, exact completion scope and remaining decisions visible
Any authorized draft write read back
known_limitations: Structural qualification does not prove every behavior
Source originals are provenance; canonical method owns execution
Specialist content/draft access may be Sara-mediated

telemetry.retention_policy: retain opaque task/source ids and hashes only
